Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
When a minion equipped with learjet plays a freak drive at end of an action, does one draw the extra card?

Learjet :
(Vehicle.
Each time you draw to replace a card this minion played as an acting minion, you may draw an additional card (discard afterward). A minion may have only one vehicle.)

Freak drive :
(Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the action). This vampire untaps.)

edit: I seem to have found the answer by myself from rules page... freak drive is played after the action but still during the action (paradox!  ) so the minion is still the acting minion and you get the extra card. Sorry for unnecessary post.

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Bloodartist wrote:
> edit: I seem to have found the answer by myself from rules page... freak drive is played after the action but still during the action (paradox!  ) so the minion is still the acting minion and you get the extra card. Sorry for unnecessary post.
>
No paradox.

Freak Drive is played after the action is resolved - so after the bleed is handled, after the referendum occurs, after the Bum's Rush combat etc. But the action hasn't finished yet, there's still a window for "after resolution" effects to be played, which is still during the action.

Messages.Body:
